integrity_notes: Proof is mathematical; finite Python checks independently test digit-sum formulas, squarefree equivalence, and local restrictions, not infinite density. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The density is exact for a particular polynomial witness family, not for all bases admitting a collision; existence for every base at least eleven is not proved. No minimal-witness classification is claimed.
title: A positive-density family of squarefree digit-sum collisions
